question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She has been working here _____ 5 years.
solution:
The correct answer is '**for**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**for**" is used to indicate a period of time. (के लिए)
 
• In the given sentence, the action of "working" has been ongoing for a duration of 5 years.
 
• The other options: "**since**," "**in**," and "**by**" do not fit the context grammatically.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She has been working here for__ 5 years.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Since**: is used to indicate a specific point in time (e.g., Since 2018).
 
• **In**: is used for locations, or time periods within a day, month, or year.
 
• **By**: is used to indicate the latest time something will occur.
